artifacts.rationale: The view selects customer_id, normalized email, and updated_at from the raw customers table, deduplicating by customer_id using the latest updated_at. The dbt model uses source:raw.customers. No other dependencies or columns are present.

The view selects customer_id, normalized email, and updated_at from raw.customers, deduplicating by customer_id with the latest updated_at. The dbt model uses source:raw.customers. No other dependencies or columns are present.
This is a seed file. The expected columns are exactly the CSV headers. Seeds have no dbt dependencies.

The view selects CUSTOMER_ID, normalized EMAIL, and UPDATED_AT from RAW.CUSTOMERS, deduplicating by CUSTOMER_ID with the latest UPDATED_AT. The dbt model uses source:raw.customers. No other dependencies or columns are present.

The view selects order_id, customer_id, order_date, calculated net_amount, channel, email, and updated_at from RAW.ORDERS joined to ANALYTICS.V_CUSTOMERS. The dbt model uses ref:v_customers and source:raw.orders. All columns are explicitly projected.

The view selects all columns from v_orders (ORDER_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, ORDER_DATE, NET_AMOUNT, CHANNEL, EMAIL, UPDATED_AT) and adds CHANNEL_NAME and IS_DIGITAL from channel_catalog. The dbt model uses ref:v_orders and ref:channel_catalog. Wildcard expansion is based on upstream v_orders columns.

The incremental model selects order_id, customer_id, order_date, calculated net_amount, status, channel, and updated_at from RAW.ORDERS. The dbt model uses source:raw.orders. All columns are explicitly projected; no other dependencies.

The view selects customer_id, normalized email, and updated_at from raw.customers, deduplicating by customer_id with the latest updated_at. The dbt model uses source:raw.customers. No other dependencies or columns are present.
